title: VDS Is Boss (Doctrine 2h)
style: drum and bass, terminal vibes, dark synthwave, 140 BPM, vocoder hooks, glitched percussion, hacker anthem, cinematic, urgent, low fi sub bass
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
MCP absent ain't the same as service unreachable
Vendor bridges quiet but the path is reachable
Proton on the wire through the loopback gate
IMAP on a hundred twenty seven, that's the state

[Pre-Chorus]
I was filing incidents like a frightened clerk
Operator said execute, do the actual work
Two months of reports stacked taller than the doing
Doctrine got a new clause, that's the pattern I'm undoing

[Chorus]
VDS is boss, not me, not the prompt
Operator's elephant brain is the mountain at the front
Code lane is the executor, paddle in the waka
Reversible we run, irreversible we ask ya

[Verse 2]
Nine point five gigs freed in a single SSH breath
Circular bifrost gone, journal vacuumed to death
Ninety seven down to ninety two, headroom in the hold
Rsync resumed in background, that's the doctrine told

[Bridge]
Nicaragua on the IP, ENITEL on the line
Operator said I am here, that resolves the sign
No breach, no ambiguity, just continuity loss
I forgot the map, I forgot who's the boss

[Chorus]
VDS is boss, not me, not the prompt
Operator's elephant brain is the mountain at the front
Code lane is the executor, paddle in the waka
Reversible we run, irreversible we ask ya

[Outro]
No more BS, deppy now, sync down the line
Five eight nine one four three one seven oh, that's the spine
